subject: Cordaites juvenile upland broad-strap woody seed tree
factual_scope: Conservative genus-level juvenile upland cordaitalean reconstruction. Falcon-Lang/Bashforth2005 primary abstract supports woody upland tree architecture and explicitly sterile reconstruction. Original Seward specimen pixels and Alberta collection text support broad strap leaves and parallel venation. Published giant adult size is NOT equated to chosen juvenile art scene scale. Crown, count and palette artistic.
identifying_features: One straight tapering woody trunk with bare lower half and seven unequal upper woody limbs, each with three distal twigs. Select juvenile upland tree habit, not coastal/mangrove or shrub habit.

Each twig bears five individual broad simple long ribbon leaves,105 leaves total. Leaves retain near-parallel edges through much of length with a modest rounded-taper tip, gently curved in full spatial depth.
Five equal subtle longitudinal material bands cue parallel venation without one dominant midrib. No compound palm/fern fronds, conifer needle sprays, reproductive organs or prop roots.
